lines.text: Joseph tells his steward to put each man's silver in his sack and his silver cup in the youngest one's sack.
At daybreak the brothers leave with their donkeys, and Joseph sends his steward after them to accuse them of repaying good with evil.
The steward searches the sacks from the oldest to the youngest and finds the cup in Reuben's sack.
Jacob tells his sons that one of his two sons was torn to pieces, and losing Benjamin would send him to Sheol in sorrow.
Judah says he guaranteed the boy's safety to his father, and he asks Joseph to keep him as a slave instead.
